next_phase.instructions: What is the single next phase of work that most advances a complete interior?

criteria.close_open_defects_then_bake: Close the three open defects first, then bake NavMesh and lighting, because an interior with ambiguous interaction, uncovered cells and an invisible floor is not complete at any scale
criteria.bake_navmesh_and_lighting_first: Bake NavMesh, occlusion and lightmaps first because nothing else can be judged until the space renders and agents can move
criteria.investigate_vertical_circulation: Investigate how the upper 7,336 sqm connects, because an interior that is one floor out of several is not the building
criteria.confirm_zone_purposes: Confirm zone purposes against the public facility guide before adding anything else

defect_priority.instructions: Among the three open defects, which must be fixed first?

criteria.flipped_normals: The flipped floor normals, because a floor the runtime raycast passes through silently breaks every interaction placed on it and the defect is invisible until something is built there
criteria.proximity_pair: The 0.44m pair, because it is a live interaction ambiguity in content that already exists
criteria.uncovered_cells: The 8 uncovered cells, because they are a live regulation non-compliance

lighting_approach.instructions: Interior lighting has never been examined. How should it be approached?

criteria.measure_before_authoring: Measure the current luminance inside the concourse first — capture from the player camera and sample it — then decide whether any light needs authoring
criteria.author_lights_immediately: Author interior lights now based on typical station lighting design
criteria.bake_and_see: Bake lightmaps with current settings and judge from the result

upper_floors.instructions: The upper floors hold 7,336 sqm with zero reachability. What does completeness require?

criteria.measure_then_decide: Measure whether vertical circulation exists in the source geometry before deciding; if stairs exist the reachability failure is a probe or collider problem, if they do not then authoring them would be arbitrary placement
criteria.exclude_upper_floors: Declare the 2F concourse the product scope and exclude the upper floors
